dct_description_sm:
This dataset delineates the geographic boundaries used to define emergency service response areas 
across Prince Edward Island. These zones support dispatch operations, emergency planning, and public 
safety coordination by identifying which emergency service provider is responsible for each area.

Each row represents a single Emergency Service Zone polygon and its associated attributes.
